cases.name: legacy_default_parity
cases.assert: With proposed mode off, exact recipes/calls/ordering/worker budgets/report values remain baseline-identical.

cases.name: complete_prefix_required
cases.assert: No optional worker until both tasks have validated fullfit/CSV/closed API and fresh cleanup; missing proof refuses.

cases.name: chronological_admission
cases.assert: Future duration/value mutation does not change any earlier decision; only past matching costs matter.

cases.name: failure_is_not_zero
cases.assert: Timeout/nonfinite/zero/missing durations do not lower estimated cost; failure metrics remain null and included.

cases.name: cold_or_scope_change
cases.assert: New schema/rows/feature/selector/capacity envelope uses600 or refuses, without borrowing another task/control median.

cases.name: reserve_exact_boundary
cases.assert: At estimate+reserve+cleanup admit; one tick below refuse; serialization delay forces immediate recheck.

cases.name: estimate_underpredicts
cases.assert: Independent watchdog ends optional work before protected reserve; known descendants are cleaned or campaign stops.

cases.name: single_pending
cases.assert: One candidate must complete both research splits/refit/export or be discarded before a second task gains refit debt.

cases.name: sampler_prefix_state
cases.assert: Continued ask/tell proposals match uninterrupted sampler chronology, including anchor/failed/duplicate/startup trials; no anchor reset.

cases.name: incumbent_atomicity
cases.assert: Any optional fit/refit/export failure leaves both original qualified export bytes untouched.

cases.name: no_outer_or_extra_api
cases.assert: Changing sealed evaluator labels cannot change proposals/admission; optional phase opens zero gateway requests.

cases.name: shared_clock_complete_denominator
cases.assert: No deadline reset through retries/resume/branch; failed task/cut remains present and invalid, never silently dropped.

cases.name: support_and_metrics
cases.assert: Identical independent quality/support calculation for both arms; utilization/trial count alone cannot qualify promotion.
